title: EmDash templates resolve astro, @astrojs/node and sharp to their first fixed release
steps: S1: From the repo root at the commit under test, for each of packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-{base,business,saas}/pnpm-lock.yaml, read the `importers` row of the template and record the resolved `version` of astro, @astrojs/node and sharp.
expect: In all three templates: astro >= 7.2.8, @astrojs/node >= 11.1.3, sharp >= 0.35.5 (pre-fix: 7.0.0, 11.0.0 and 0.34.5).
evidence: Measured 17/10/2026: the base template image built from develop answers 500 to a request with Host: 127.0.0.1:99999999999; the image built from this branch answers 404 and keeps serving. pnpm audit per template: 2 critical / 19 high before, 0 critical / 6 high after.
